mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5pp over 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp over 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 5% YoY but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth is above 3% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a tight labor market and potential inflationary pressures that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth > 3% YoY and UNRATE < 4% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising by more than 3% year-over-year, it signals a potential inflationary regime that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 2% and CPIAUCSL rising > 3% YoY but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in GDP (GDPC1) is positive and accelerating, and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a strong economic expansion that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerating and UNRATE < 5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.
